expectedIssues: Middle card in the carousel is not aligned with the other cards
reportedIssues: In the "Fastest near you" carousel the cards are not aligned on a shared baseline: the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) image starts ~25px lower than the neighbouring cards, so its title and delivery-fee lines sit below those of the other cards, making the row look jumbled.

The first card's image (Green Bowl Poké) renders on a pale gray/white background while the other cards use dark photo-style backgrounds, and its time badge sits at a different vertical offset. It reads as a broken/placeholder image.
Favorite heart buttons are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a plain white outline heart with no background, while the card below has a heart inside a dark circular chip.
Secondary text such as "€0.90 delivery", "25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen" and the tab labels use light gray on white, which may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast requirement.

expected.reasoning: Issue 0 directly describes the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) being misaligned vertically relative to neighboring cards in the carousel, causing the entire row to appear jumbled.
